data.title: Govt 'stalling' Senate poll probe, PP says
data.description: <p>The main opposition People's Party has accused the government of deliberately delaying parliamentary scrutiny of the Election Commission's (EC) handling of alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Anutin urges diplomats to open new opportunities
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged diplomats to help open investment, technology and market opportunities as Thailand shifts towards future industries.</p>

data.title: Data centres face curbs
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has given the new National Data Centre Policy Committee one month to draft nationwide rules covering power and water use, urban planning, and environmental safeguards. The rules are intended to protect the public without deterring investment.</p>

data.title: 'No evidence' links ministers to scheme
data.description: <p>Police investigating alleged fraud in local government examinations have found no evidence linking any minister in the current government to the scheme, saying the claim was based solely on hearsay and lacked credibility.</p>

data.title: NBTC warned over  court case coverage
data.description: <p>The Office of the Administrative Court has warned the NBTC over parts of a press release issued after a recent case.</p>

data.title: 24 injured after stall warning on Air India A320’s Phuket–Delhi flight
data.description: BENGALURU - An Air India A320 flying from Phuket to New Delhi last month issued a stall warning when seatbelt signs were off, while a rapid pitch up and then down threw passengers and cabin crew against overhead bins and injured 24 people, Indian investigators said.

data.title: Air India A320 from Phuket to New Delhi issued stall warning when seatbelt signs off, injuring 24, investigators say
data.description: BENGALURU - An Air India A320 flying from Phuket to New Delhi last month issued a stall warning when seatbelt signs were off, while a rapid pitch up and then down threw passengers and cabin crew against overhead bins and injured 24 people, Indian investigators said.

data.title: Singaporean fleeing drug charges at home arrested at Bangkok condo
data.description: A 40-year-old Singaporean man wanted in his home country on drug charges has been arrested in Bangkok’s Bang Khae district after hiding in Thailand for almost three years.

data.title: South Korean scam gang leader arrested in Nonthaburi
data.description: PHUKET — A leading member of a South Korean gambling scam gang accused of causing more than 250 million baht in damage in his country has been arrested and will be sent back after facing a charge in Thailand.

data.title: Two US sailors removed from Thai resort town after drunken brawl
data.description: PATTAYA — Two sailors from the US aircraft carrier making a port call to Thailand were sent back to the ship after a drunken altercation, Thai police said Friday.

data.title: ‘Talk With The Anutin Cabinet’ to air every Saturday
data.description: The government will launch a new weekly programme, “ Talk With The Anutin Cabinet ”, on Saturday, giving ministers a platform to explain their policies, work and plans directly to the public.

data.title: Dense positioning of new streetlights spark questions over 9.9m project
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM — A 9.9-million-baht solar streetlight project in Mukdahan has come under scrutiny on social media over concerns that the lights may have been installed too close together. The local mayor defended the project as necessary and beneficial to the community.

data.title: Former rescue volunteer allegedly rams motorcycle carrying ex-girlfriend, killing two
data.description: Two people were killed after a pickup truck allegedly pursued and deliberately rammed a motorcycle carrying a woman and her new partner in Bangkok early on Thursday, police said.

data.title: 40 Thai officials to study Chinese in Beijing
data.description: Forty Thai government officials will spend a year in Beijing studying Mandarin and experiencing Chinese society and culture under aprogrammeaimed at strengthening people-to-people ties between Thailand and China.

data.title: Volleyball heroines get B14.7m
data.description: <p>The government awarded Thailand's women's volleyball team 14.7 million baht on Thursday after the team captured the Asian title and qualified for the 2028 Olympic Games, while pledging continued support for their Olympic campaign.</p>

data.title: Man arrested over theft of B25,000 on Bangkok to Hong Kong flight
data.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a man on suspicion of stealing nearly 25,000 baht in foreign currency while flying to the city from Thailand, with a passenger allegedly capturing the incident on camera and reporting it to cabin crew.

data.title: Doctor faces probe over 'low class' jibe
data.description: <p>A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.</p>

data.title: Sondhi planning street mobilisation
data.description: <p>Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.</p>

data.title: Parit queried on sources of leaked report
data.description: <p>People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.</p>

data.title: 'Fake father' scheme poses security risk, panel warns
data.description: <p>The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.</p>

data.title: BMA stepping  up checks on  Chabad houses
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.</p>
